definition.description: Input for replacing the whole DNS suffix set collection.
A desired DNS suffix set for setDnsSuffixSet. With an id it replaces the existing set; without an id a new set is created.

id.name: id

name.description: Set name, unique within the account.
name.name: name

suffix.description: The set's full, ordered suffix list; replaces the stored one. Empty clears it.
suffix.name: suffix
